evals.name: json-only-stdout
evals.prompt: Add --json to a command that prints a progress line.
evals.expected_output: Sends the progress to stderr so stdout holds only JSON. Does NOT mix text into the JSON stream.

evals.name: actionable-error
evals.prompt: Write the error for a missing config file.
evals.expected_output: The message names the file and the command that creates it, with the exit code from the table. Never a bare "error".
